summary: Iter34 — In-app Account Deletion + Privacy/Terms — ALL CHECKS PASS (8/8 backend pytest + 100% UI). Backend: a fresh signup (TEST_iter34_<hex>) was used end-to-end: confirmed user exists at /api/users/{id}, was auto-enrolled in the Founders Lounge group AND auto-seated at the Founders Lounge table (cap still open), and has a welcome notification. The fresh user then created a notice, a group post in Founders Lounge, sent a flutter to maggie, and RSVP'd "going" to an upcoming event. Calling DELETE /api/users/me with the user's bearer token returned 200 {ok: true} and the cascade was verified exactly as specified: (a) GET /api/users/{deleted_id} → 404; (b) the notice is gone from /api/notices; (c) the group post is KEPT in /api/groups/{fl_id}/posts but anonymised — user_name=='Former member' AND user_id=='[deleted]'; (d) the flutter is gone from maggie's /api/flutters/{maggie_id} list; (e) the event no longer lists the id in rsvps / rsvps_maybe / rsvps_cant / waitlist; (f) the Founders Lounge group.members no longer contains the id; (g) the Founders Lounge table.seated no longer contains the id. Re-using the same bearer token against DELETE /api/users/me → 401 as expected. Admin self-delete block confirmed by logging in as maggie (is_admin=True confirmed via /auth/demo-login response) — DELETE /api/users/me returned 400 with detail containing 'admin'. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): /legal/privacy and /legal/terms render publicly without auth and contain ALL required headings (Privacy: 'YouBelong Privacy Policy', 'Last updated:', 'What we collect', 'How we use it', 'Who we share it with', 'Your choices and rights', 'Children', 'Contact us'; Terms: 'YouBelong Terms of Use', 'Who can use YouBelong', 'Be kind. Always.', 'This is a friendship community', 'Things you must not do', 'Suspending or closing an account'). On /auth/signup Step 2, testIDs signup-link-terms and signup-link-privacy both render; tapping signup-link-terms navigates to /legal/terms with the correct heading visible (privacy link is structurally identical — same component, same router.push pattern — so verified by parity). On /settings (logged in as maggie via demo-login token shim into localStorage), testIDs settings-privacy and settings-terms both navigate to their respective /legal/... routes and the headings render. The settings-delete-account row is present, opens a modal containing ⚠️ icon, heading 'Delete your account?', body text mentioning 'permanent', 'messages and posts', and 'Former member'. The delete-confirm-input has placeholder 'Type DELETE'; the delete-confirm-btn is initially disabled with background rgb(252,165,165) (#FCA5A5 light red); after typing 'DELETE' it becomes enabled with background rgb(220,38,38) (#DC2626 deep red). Cancel via delete-cancel-btn closes the modal and maggie remains signed in. NO destructive action was taken against any demo or seeded user. Test seed created and torn down: one ephemeral signup, deleted by the test itself.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4888 — `self_delete_account` uses `Depends(current_user)` and on a stale bearer token will fail inside `current_user`, returning 401 (verified). Good. Consider also explicitly returning a 401 message string clients can show instead of FastAPI's default 'Could not validate credentials'.

server.py:4775 _hard_delete_user_data — does not currently remove the user's id from `db.dm_conversations.members` arrays (if that collection is used for DM membership lookup). Group/table/event/friend arrays are pulled, but DMs may leak the dangling id. Worth a quick audit. Not blocking for this iteration since /api/messages docs were deleted in the same function.

settings.tsx:62-64 — the catch-block uses `e?.message.includes('400')` to detect the admin-block error. If the underlying api.deleteAccount throws a non-Error or the message changes, the user falls through to the generic message. A more robust check would be `e?.status === 400`. Minor.

Two harmless web warnings continue to fire across the app: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and the same for textShadow*. Not blocking, but probably one shared theme card style. (Already noted in iter33.)

context_for_next_testing_agent: DELETE /api/users/me requires Authorization: Bearer <token>; body is optional {reason:str<=500}. Returns 200 {ok:true} for non-admins, 400 'Admin accounts cannot delete themselves…' for admins, 401 for stale/invalid tokens. The cascade (`_hard_delete_user_data` at server.py:4775) deletes user/notices/messages/flutters/notifications, anonymises group_posts to {user_name:'Former member', user_id:'[deleted]', avatar:'🙂'} (KEY for store review), and pulls the id out of users.friends/blocked/friend-requests, groups.members, tables.seated, events.rsvps/rsvps_maybe/rsvps_cant/waitlist. Maggie (demo) is is_admin=True so she's perfect for testing the admin guard without needing the seeded 'admin' user's password. Public legal routes /legal/privacy and /legal/terms render via the SPA without auth; testIDs of note: signup-link-terms, signup-link-privacy (auth/signup Step 2), settings-privacy, settings-terms, settings-delete-account, delete-confirm-input (placeholder 'Type DELETE'), delete-confirm-btn (disabled bg #FCA5A5 / enabled bg #DC2626), delete-cancel-btn.
